# Vinh Nguyen (Vincent)

> Front-End Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience architecting enterprise web platforms and leading engineering teams for Fortune 500 companies.

## About

Vinh Nguyen (also known as Vincent) is a Front-End Technical Lead based in Vietnam. He specializes in building high-performance, accessible, and scalable web applications. He has led engineering teams across global enterprise projects, mentored 50+ engineers, and built platforms serving 200+ international markets.

- Portfolio: https://vinhnguyenba.dev
- Blog: https://vinhnguyenba.dev/blog
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vinh-nguyen-479781130
- GitHub: https://github.com/glorynguyen

## Current Role

**Frontend Technical Lead at Huge** (August 2025 – Present)
Working on PepsiCo's Global Platform for 200+ markets.
- Architecting core front-end systems: Global Search (OpenSearch), build-time redirect framework
- Led migration to Next.js 15 and React 19 with Core Web Vitals optimization
- Established engineering standards for TypeScript, component modularity, and CI/CD
- Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, Sitecore JSS, GraphQL, TypeScript, OpenSearch

## Career History

- **Front-End Lead at Astek Vietnam – Decathlon E-commerce** (Aug 2023 – Aug 2025): Led front-end for Decathlon's e-commerce platform scaling from Singapore to APAC. Next.js, React, TypeScript.
- **Full Stack Leader at Syntrino Solutions** (Feb 2020 – Aug 2023): Led a team for a Malaysian company. Built attendance tracking, shift scheduler, and voice detection systems. Next.js, React Native, .NET Core.
- **Senior Application Developer at PERSOL** (Apr 2019 – Feb 2020): R&D team focused on AI chatbots and PWA. Integrated Azure QnA Maker and TensorFlow.
- **Senior Front-End Developer at Appable** (Aug 2017 – Apr 2019): Early-stage startup. Best employee of the year. Pioneered React adoption.
- **Front-End Developer at Seldat Distribution** (Aug 2016 – Aug 2017): AngularJS enterprise applications.
- **Software Engineer at Global CyberSoft** (Oct 2014 – Aug 2016): Started career in R&D Big Data.

## Technical Skills

- **Leadership**: Technical Architecture, Team Mentoring, Sprint Planning, Code Reviews, Stakeholder Communication
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Angular, React Native, Vue.js, Astro, PWA
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, GraphQL
- **Performance**: Core Web Vitals, ISR, SSG, SSR, WebAssembly, WebGPU
- **CMS**: Sitecore XP/JSS, ContentStack, Headless CMS, Bynder DAM
- **DevOps**: CI/CD, Git, Azure, Docker
- **AI**: MCP Servers, Azure QnA Maker, TensorFlow, AI Chatbots
